Brokerages Set Nifty Targets, Recommend Sector Bets

Two financial brokerages, Citi and JP Morgan, have issued their targets for the Nifty index. Citi set a June 2027 target of 26,800, while JP Morgan retained its target at 27,000. Both firms expressed a constructive outlook on Indian equities. Citi is favouring financials, telecom, healthcare, and utilities, while remaining underweight on IT services, staples, and metals. JP Morgan is betting on power and data centre sectors, citing a capital expenditure push.
